bio: For over 30 years, this elegant restaurant with a pleasant terrace has been making the most of its wonderful location on the marina. The menu is inspired by the seasons; there is also an appetising set menu, which changes on a monthly basis, but the classics are just as much in demand. Book your spot at the traditional seafood festival – Festival de Fruits de Mer – from late November to late January. Other highlights are the extensive wine list, and friendly, professional service....
